charts.title: Account Health Score
charts.description: Account health score is 85/100, indicating a healthy and engaged customer with low churn risk.
charts.insight: Strong engagement metrics and positive support history. Customer is in the green zone with expansion potential.

charts.title: Platform Usage Trend (6 Months)
charts.description: Consistent upward trend in platform adoption with no significant dips.
charts.insight: Usage momentum is strong. 62% growth in active users over 6 months suggests high product-market fit. Good signal for upsell conversations.

charts.title: Feature Engagement Heatmap
charts.description: Dashboard and Reports are most-used features. Analytics usage growing rapidly from 45% to 70% over 4 weeks.
charts.insight: Analytics feature shows strongest growth. Customer is becoming more data-driven. Consider highlighting advanced analytics capabilities in the call.

charts.title: Session Distribution by Department
charts.description: Engineering team is the primary user base, followed by Operations.
charts.insight: Engineering adoption is strong (John Smith's team). Finance usage at 15% suggests Lisa Park's team is starting to engage. Good opportunity to expand Finance use cases.

charts.title: Support Ticket Trend
charts.description: Ticket volume decreased 75% over 3 months. Zero open tickets currently.
charts.insight: Excellent support health. Declining ticket volume indicates product stability and customer proficiency. Use this as proof point for CFO.

charts.title: SLA Compliance
charts.description: All support metrics well within SLA targets.
charts.insight: 100% SLA compliance demonstrates operational excellence. Strong proof point for enterprise readiness.

kpi_summary.key_insight: Customer shows strong product adoption with 62% user growth. Zero support tickets and 100% SLA compliance. Analytics feature adoption is accelerating, suggesting readiness for advanced tier discussion.

charts.title: Account Health Score
charts.description: Account health score is 72/100, in the watch zone pending pilot KPI attainment.
charts.insight: Health score is moderate. Expansion depends on pilot success metrics and security sign-off.

charts.title: Pilot Adoption (2 Warehouses)
charts.description: Adoption growing steadily across both pilot warehouse sites.
charts.insight: 37% growth in pilot users after onboarding improvements. On track for Q3 expansion if KPIs hold.

charts.title: Support Ticket Summary
charts.description: One low-priority open ticket. SLA adherence on target.
charts.insight: Support health is good for pilot scale. No blocker-level incidents.

kpi_summary.key_insight: Pilot showing positive adoption trajectory. Security and legal alignment needed before steering committee. Expansion potential for Q3 if pilot KPIs are met.
